description: Use this for how to get to Kamakura, Kita-Kamakura or Enoshima by train from Tokyo Station, Shinjuku, Shibuya, Shinagawa, Yokohama, Haneda Airport, Narita Airport or Fujisawa: which line, how many changes, minutes and the IC card fare, plus the Odakyu and Romancecar option from Shinjuku.
